import asyncio

from seed import AstNode_Llm, AsyncSeedApi

client = AsyncSeedApi(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.create_ast(
        request=AstNode_Llm(
            model="model",
        ),
    )


asyncio.run(main())
